subject: Intro & next steps: budget owner intro + procurement/security routing

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: routing to budget owner and procurement/security

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the 30-min check-in this morning. Helpful to hear the team’s objectives for accelerating customer-facing workflows and the data residency constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can get the right stakeholders involved: 

- Goal: reduce per-interaction latency and inference cost for your in-product assistants (pilot scope: 3 product flows).
- Success metrics you mentioned: sub-300ms 95th percentile for chat response plus <=50% token-cost reduction vs today.
- Compliance note: customer data must remain within US regions; SOC2 evidence and audit logs will be required for procurement.

As discussed, could you introduce the person who owns budget approval for this initiative (e.g., finance or product sponsor) and the procurement/security contacts who will own the legal/KYC flow? If easier, a single intro with all three is fine. Once we have those folks we can share a short mutual action plan and a draft commercial estimate for the pilot. 

Next steps I propose from our side:
1) I’ll prepare a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) and an eval pack with performance numbers for the suggested model/config. Attached is a preliminary eval pack for context.
2) Schedule a 30-minute intro with your budget owner + procurement/security to walk the MAP and procurement timeline.

Would Wednesday or Thursday next week work for an intro?

Thanks — looking forward to advancing this.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
---
